These are real people, real livelihoods and real public money. And Congress generally rewrites this thing once every five years. The bill McConnell helped advance is more than 900 pages. Nine. Hundred. Pages. Maybe -- just maybe -- that deserves more than somebody showing up after three months away and casting the deciding vote without the public having any meaningful idea how carefully he studied what the hell he was voting on. I 've started paying more attention to how the same story can feel completely different depending on who's reporting it. Ground News makes that easy to see by showing coverage from across the political spectrum and pointing out what certain outlets leave out. My team and I use it because it helps cut through the noise. Try it today! And that's why the victory lap we're seeing now from Republican operatives and people in the media pisses me off so much. They are spiking the football -- saying: look how stupid these Democratic content creators look... they thought Mitch McConnell was dead. Let me be very clear about something: The only reason I thought Mitch McConnell might be dead is because they wouldn't put him on camera and show him to us. You don't get to hide a sitting senator for three months, ban cameras when you finally trot him out, and then mock the people who asked where he was. And you definitely don't get to act like today's vote settles the matter. To me, today's vote makes the questions more consequential. His vote mattered. Without that twelfth Republican vote, this legislation hadn't moved. Today they had it. Today it moved. I don't like talking about any of this. I'd much rather be talking about the important issues of the day. But I can't, because Congress won't do anything about the important issues of the day. And Congress won't do anything because we have people like Mitch McConnell in power who can't physically or mentally do the job, surrounded by a whole apparatus of people willing to cover for a gerontocracy that is incapable of delivering on anything that matters to the American people. But the more I think about it, the more I realize this is one of the important issues of the day. Because this isn't really about Mitch McConnell anymore. It's about what we allow power to become in this country. It's about politicians clinging to power to the detriment of people's livelihoods and the wellbeing of our country. They can't rein in an out-of-control fascist president. They can't end this ridiculous, illegal war in Iran. They can't fix our broken economy. They can't regulate AI, or deal with the data centers and Flock cameras that are driving Americans crazy every single day. They are not capable of dealing with any of it. And it's because of exactly this. So to the pundits online who were so happy to lecture people like me: screw that. Mitch McConnell did show up again today, this time to cast the vote his Republican peers proclaimed they needed to move the farm bill forward. It's bullshit. But that doesn't erase any of my questions about what the hell is actually going on here. If I'm being honest with you, what we've seen of him this week deeply concerns me. And that's if you can even say what we have seen this week was Mitch McConnell. I don't think it really was. It was whatever's left of him. He is not capable of doing this job. It's incredibly sad. It's elder abuse. And this keeps happening in America. We have so many members of Congress who have clung to power for far too long and done nothing to create the conditions for the next generation of American politicians to step up, not just into ordinary seats, but into leadership. I am tired of this entire class of people acting like we're being annoying for asking basic questions about what the hell is going on in this country and why it keeps happening. It is not okay for a sitting member of Congress, whether it's Mitch McConnell or Tom Kean or any of the others, and that includes plenty of Democrats, to disappear for months with no update on their health. None. Why hasn't the Senate removed Mitch McConnell? Why haven't they moved the farm bill forward without him? Why haven't they stripped him of his committee assignments? That's what would happen in a functioning government. And a functioning media would spend a hell of a lot more time on this story instead of moving on the moment they got played by a bullshit dog and pony show. I remain bewildered. And I'll be honest about why I keep talking about McConnell. Yes, it gets clicks. It does. But that's not why I keep coming back to it. I keep talking about it because this story is a window into everything that is broken about American politics right now. It is maddening that we're expected to just tolerate this kind of crap. And that's before we even get to the fact that the current president of the United States is very clearly in substantial physical and cognitive decline. He doesn't know where he is half the time. He is not up for the job. And he's being taken advantage of by some of the least qualified people you have ever seen on this planet. We are in bad shape in America. And until we break up these concentrated power structures that are manipulating the American people and destroying our economy, and relentlessly, ruthlessly demand real transparency and accountability from the people who wield them, we are never going to take this country back. We are never going to get to a place where we have a government that worthy of the people it represents. Because Mitch McConnell showed up today. He cast the vote his party demanded of him was needed. A piece of legislation advanced. And somehow, after three months of gaslighting, we're supposed to believe that 'showing up' is the same thing as delivering for the American people. It's not. It's the bare minimum. The American people deserve representatives who can actually do the work -- and a government honest enough to tell us when they can't. We deserve a hell of a lot better than this. With urgency, --Mike Mike Nellis is a Democratic strategist and entrepreneur who has raised over $1 billion for Democratic campaigns and causes. body:

Hi friend,

At the Republican Midterm Convention last week, President Trump tried to hawk his strategy for this election: handing out $5,000 checks if Republicans keep control of the House and Senate. Let us call this what it is: a transparent attempt to buy an election and distract from systemic political corruption and a failing economy.

While everyday families struggle with the squeezing cost of housing, groceries, and health care, the Trump Administration is treating governance like a pay-to-play scheme. But we are not just watching this happen from the sidelines. We are taking proactive steps to safeguard our democracy and hold Washington accountable.

In Congress, I am combating President Trump’s agenda by pushing for the passage of the Freedom to Vote Act and the John Lewis Voting Rights Advancement Act to protect ballot access. I am also fighting to pass the Restore Trust in Government Act to ban stock trading for politicians — members of Congress and the President alike — because our elections should be decided by working families, not self-serving interests.

We need a House majority that will defend election integrity, protect our democratic institutions, and put working people first. Taking back the House starts right here in MD-03, but we cannot counter the Trump Administration's bribery without your support.

Will you chip in $5, $10, or $15 today to power our campaign push, fight back against President Trump's rhetoric, and defend our democracy? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/SEMD-03-Email-Sept2026-FR-RepubMidterm?&refcode=E31643-20260916-RepubMidterm-SL-2026Race&amount=5]

Congresswoman Sarah Elfreth broke barriers in 2024, becoming the youngest woman ever elected to Congress from Maryland. She went to Congress with one thing in mind: delivering for Maryland families on the issues that matter most. Whether it's standing up for federal workers, supporting veterans, protecting the Chesapeake Bay, or tackling the affordability crisis head-on, Sarah is on the front lines, fighting for what is right. And Sarah has delivered on her promises. She has spent her first year in the House advocating for the Third District, successfully passing five bills into law, solving over 1,000 constituent cases, and bringing tens of millions in funding back to her community. She learned her work ethic and tenacity from growing up in a union household and honed her skills of problem-solving and collaborating over six years in the Maryland State Senate. Fellow Conservative: In 1991, the mob came for Clarence Thomas. They smeared him. They tried to destroy his name, his reputation, and his honor. As Justice Thomas himself has put it, critics in Washington _"don't bomb you, necessarily, but they bomb your reputation or your good name or your honor."_ **He refused to cave.** And because he did, he became one of the four giants of the modern Supreme Court — alongside Justices Scalia, Alito, and Rehnquist. Senator Ted Cruz has just released a remarkable new book: _**Going Further: The Incomparable Clarence Thomas**_ , built on exclusive interviews with the Justice himself.

---
|
---
[](http://links.conservativesdefendingfreedom.com/u/click?_t=91d01aa68bbe4105984439520ca0f0af&_m=03283c6afe244f49b0be87794f812b67&_e=IhrvLATJA7gJu9VS9v3lQ_IEHjFh8Z_GW4VCdqnJfbSy4mqmJuygsiMZ5s8sM8EAnpATL3nFivh322B4Db2zrbHj_yViKoTzHT8mvcSMPQ53QxtfhksQ9NzGiGKQnUuQWM-JSRzilUKpvVk72pLEwyjCTQO1I-DNJZ4-unmKzq1q4Rw-53OC8FfgX8fMLXNJ3zt0RebATcPLzQgpFEjE8J59Ew9gvOn0rivqWPMAgks9iachHXw7mt2xabxSUEjVcLxFzpyZH5JCT8oKM9gut1sTpoq-EKZUTLvG-Dl8zsEx4Vk7SJGZC3S_xSUPtStwCpB37GzjvbqBDIJfL0nHTX812nanRH7rgG5fr4FtEdRMnKMULLSmO9M13LMXn5SbI3T1Qc7_PY8oWcH3MwuZbg%3D%3D)
---

It tells the story of a man who rose from grinding poverty in Pin Point, Georgia — raised by a grandfather he calls _"the single greatest human being I've ever met"_ — to become, in Cruz's words, the justice _"more willing to go back to the original Constitution... and to overturn precedent" than any other in history._

There's a moment in the book that says everything. When Justice Scalia told Thomas he was _"tilting at windmills"_ by trying to overturn bad precedent, Thomas shot back: _"Nino, windmills are dangerous."_

That is the kind of courage we need on the federal bench. And here is the part every conservative must understand:

**Clarence Thomas only reached the Supreme Court because the Senate confirmed him by just two votes.**

Presidents nominate judges. But the Senate confirms them. Every originalist on the bench, and every one we hope to see there, depends on having conservative senators willing to fight. When we lose the Senate, we lose the courts. It's that simple.

That's the mission of the Senate Conservatives Fund: electing principled conservatives to the U.S. Senate so we can confirm the next generation of Clarence Thomases, and stop the Left from ever again turning a confirmation hearing into a character assassination.

So today, we want to put Senator Cruz's book in your hands.

**When you contribute $50 or more to the Senate Conservatives Fund, we'll send you a copy of _Going Further: The Incomparable Clarence Thomas_ as our thank-you.** [**Please join us in the effort to build a conservative Senate by making a contribution today.**](http://links.conservativesdefendingfreedom.com/u/click?_t=91d01aa68bbe4105984439520ca0f0af&_m=03283c6afe244f49b0be87794f812b67&_e=IhrvLATJA7gJu9VS9v3lQ_IEHjFh8Z_GW4VCdqnJfbSy4mqmJuygsiMZ5s8sM8EAnpATL3nFivh322B4Db2zrbHj_yViKoTzHT8mvcSMPQ6kdpOh8j5jtOW-lRyxg7pa3ofF75Fj3rjSwOU4i4cB-lLar-OL62j97y95PMr_H09yGOlccQyZEU-VX85MD6I5DrLO3b-JA3FpiGd92F-oCe2E8kTsTsk5Qozo5ZgKnfiPbV5I4oi0cjUiJZL179taQxPOGdWWERjczW21IexeClxrdgMNYPQF1l1NOgUmmJz8VG-jB4cYhPzu-ekIJQq9Vbl9kjNGlliHNrEGNfA0RtCrdZEwqjgkeKRw-q-Sex8yVPqvQdMdXz7lce1cTy6JbmKVhKrR7_sM06vFy-vJww%3D%3D) Your support will help elect the conservative senators who will confirm judges like Justice Thomas — and will help make sure the next conservative nominee who refuses to bow to the woke mob has the votes to win. Clarence Thomas went further. Now it's our turn.

There's a moment in the book that says everything. When Justice Scalia told Thomas he was "tilting at windmills" by trying to overturn bad precedent, Thomas shot back: "Nino, windmills are dangerous." That is the kind of courage we need on the federal bench. And here is the part every conservative must understand: Clarence Thomas only reached the Supreme Court because the Senate confirmed him by just two votes. Presidents nominate judges. But the Senate confirms them. Every originalist on the bench, and every one we hope to see there, depends on having conservative senators willing to fight. When we lose the Senate, we lose the courts. It's that simple. That's the mission of the Senate Conservatives Fund: electing principled conservatives to the U.S. Senate so we can confirm the next generation of Clarence Thomases, and stop the Left from ever again turning a confirmation hearing into a character assassination. So today, we want to put Senator Cruz's book in your hands. Your support will help elect the conservative senators who will confirm judges like Justice Thomas — and will help make sure the next conservative nominee who refuses to bow to the woke mob has the votes to win. Clarence Thomas went further. Now it's our turn. It's a win-win. You will help elect strong conservative U.S. Senate candidates, and you will get a hardcover copy of this best-selling book. Thank you for considering this request and for doing so much to help fight for America's future. For Freedom, Co-Founder & CEOSenate Conservatives Fund P.S. body:
Sisters and Brothers -
Let me take a minute to tell you why I am strongly supporting Dr. Abdul El-Sayed for Senate in this extremely important midterm election.
We are living in an unprecedented and dangerous moment in American history. At a time when the very rich are getting richer while working families struggle, the same old, same old establishment politics and establishment policies are no longer good enough.
**We need change. We need real change. And that's what Abdul is all about.**
**[Support Abdul ››](https://act.abdulformichigan.com/go/507?c0=em-ms-aes-20260916-3-ak.THl7zD&amount=10&refcode=em20260916-3204&t=2&akid=3209%2E251025%2EfGy1iM)**
Unlike Donald Trump, Abdul understands that you don't cut Medicaid and throw 15 million Americans off the healthcare they have in order to give huge tax breaks to billionaires. As a medical doctor, he has seen firsthand how our current healthcare system is broken and dysfunctional. He knows that healthcare is a human right and that we need to pass Medicare for All so that we can guarantee healthcare to every man, woman, and child in our country.
Abdul understands that unchecked artificial intelligence and robotics are a danger to the environment, our kids, our democracy, our economy, and the very future of humanity. He knows that we need to stand up to the big tech oligarchs and that we need a pause on advanced AI development until we establish clear safety standards.
Abdul knows that while 60% of our people are living paycheck to paycheck, spending tens of billions of dollars on illegal wars overseas is wrong and not what the American people want. He will work to end Donald Trump's unconstitutional war in Iran, end military aid to the extremist Netanyahu government in Israel, and invest in our schools, our hospitals, and our communities.
Abdul believes we must never accept a corrupt campaign finance system that allows billionaires to undermine our democracy and buy elections. We need to end _Citizens United_ and get super PACs out of the political process and move to public funding of elections.
These are tough times for our country. Working families need strong representation to take on the power of the billionaire class.
**Peter, please send Dr. Abdul El-Sayed to the U.S. Senate.**[_**Chip in $10 or any amount today to help make that happen:**_](https://act.abdulformichigan.com/go/507?c0=em-ms-aes-20260916-3-ak.THl7zD&amount=10&refcode=em20260916-3204&t=3&akid=3209%2E251025%2EfGy1iM)
**[Donate $10 ››](https://act.abdulformichigan.com/go/507?c0=em-ms-aes-20260916-3-ak.THl7zD&amount=10&refcode=em20260916-3204&t=22&akid=3209%2E251025%2EfGy1iM)**
In solidarity,
Bernie Sanders
